newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ISL marketing agency opens Beijing office.
newsitem.headline: ISL marketing agency opens Beijing office.

text.p: International sports marketing agency ISL said it had opened a new office in Beijing and billed itself as the first agency offering a full range of services in the world's most populous country.

"The array of services offered through the new office in Beijing creates an important platform for ISL to expand its long-term relationships and business activity in central China," it said in a statement.

It said ISL intended to play a leading role in marketing sports events. It cited Chinese athletes' increasing success, the development of a middle class in urban areas and brand-name manufacturers' efforts to tap the huge consumer market.
"In addition to Chinese sports media and marketing activities, important synergies for global sales of television and marketing rights should be achieved," it said.
David Canalupo will run the China office and report to Chris Renner, senior vice president and manager of ISL Asia Pacific in Hong Kong.
